# FPL Skill

> Advisory Fantasy Premier League tooling. Account writes fail closed. Repository contracts are authoritative; passing software tests is not evidence of predictive competence.

## Evidence boundary

Do not claim predictive competence, calibration accuracy, decision uplift, or FPL-winning capability from passing tests, synthetic fixtures, metric definitions, or retrospective examples. Such claims require reproducible, leakage-resistant, out-of-sample evidence against actual outcomes. Missing actual outcomes must remain `NO_TRACK_RECORD_YET` or `INSUFFICIENT_DATA`; never fabricate metrics or impute missing outcomes as zero.

## Governance holds

Phase 3, P1–P15, and live FPL account writes remain **STRICT HOLD**. `execute_account_mutation` discards injected write transport/session objects and raises the canonical `fpl_skill.approval_gate.ExecutionDenied`; read-only bootstrap or account-state fetches may occur before refusal. This index does not authorize account mutations or override repository governance.
